t: SUMMIT UPLINK: Recovery terminal online. Last full heal before the Great Telescope.
APEX ARRAY. Lift gate: Observatory Halls of the Quorum. Road east: the Great Telescope.
CRYSTAL HALL, 1F. Seat of Quorum member Marisol Fenn.
Step into the orrery column to ride up to the Sonic Hall.
SONIC HALL, 2F. Seat of Quorum member Duke Harrow.
The dome hums a low chord. The right staircase climbs to 3F.
PLASMA HALL, 3F. Seat of the silent Quorum member Saga.
A lone flame burns in the orb. The right staircase climbs to 4F.
GRAVITY HALL, 4F. Seat of Quorum member General Ostrander.
Beyond this hall, only the Prime Linker waits at the Great Telescope.
STAR CHART: Every Linker world is pinned here, Dustara to Starfall.
One faint point past the Rift has no name, only a note: 'Ystra?'
Ace Linker: I beat the Quorum once. Then they beat me four times. Heal before every hall.
Astronomer: The thin air up here makes the sky so clear. On a good night you can see the Rift glow.
Summit guard: Only Linkers with all eight Signal Shards ride the lift. Go on, you've earned it.
Ace Linker: Crystal types shrug off hits but crack under heavy blows. Bring something that hits hard.
Astronomer: The dome here was tuned to hear radio stars. Now it mostly hears guitar solos.
Summit guard: Nobody has heard Saga speak. The battle does the talking.
Ace Linker: Gravity moves hit like a landslide. Lighten your team and keep your Pods ready.
Summit guard: Prime Linker Orra Venn bonded the very first Alienmon. Show respect, then show your best.
Astronomer: Every Signal Shard you carried lit a world on these charts. Helix wanted the map for itself.
Archivist: Quiet, please. The star charts are older than the Linker League itself.

notes: Apex Array: Summit Lift (146) is the hub. Lift gate (17-18,4) -> Observatory Halls 1F-4F (Crystal, Sonic, Plasma, Gravity) chained by stairs; 147 uses its orrery column as the up-lift and 150 arrives at its orrery. Library (152) is the dish building top-left (5,4). Recovery terminal ('bay') at the uplink consoles (19,12) bottom-right, shop at the striped stall (2,6); no nurse/clerk pinned because there is no tile behind those outdoor counters. Quorum members are NOT placed (story characters) - the lead should add them as trainers/bosses in 147-150 if wanted (good standing tiles: 147 (8,7)/(7,9), 148 (7,9), 149 (8,5), 150 (7,9)). Orra Venn keeper at 151 (7,6) top of the central steps, challenged from (7,7).
